items.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019
items.q: Some of the other trumpet players were Al Vizzutti, and Vince DiMartino and Jeff Tysik was there. And you know, Joe Mosello. And that’s the band I played with.

ctx.x: Oh, you were a trumpet major.

That was my major at Eastman, the trumpet, a performance major. I was at first an education major and than I got into this place and I said wow, so this is what, how moving this thing can be. And I had basically no skills, I mean comparatively to other people that came in. I’m not — it was just amazing. Some of the other trumpet players were Al Vizzutti, and Vince DiMartino and Jeff Tysik was there. And you know, Joe Mosello. And that’s the band I played with. I was playing fifth trumpet. And Chuck Mangione was…
I know what you mean. There’s a lot of music out there.
